# Validation

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "psms",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Theory = "psms-theory.html",
    Implementation = "psms-implementation.html",
    Benchmarks = "psms-benchmarks.html",
    Validation = "psms-validation.html"
  )
)
```

PSMS is checked against numerical prolate-spheroid boundary-value calculations for the same outer geometry, medium properties, material contrasts, and reporting quantity.

::: {.tip data-title="Reading the residuals"}
Mean behavior is easier to judge from the signed rows than from a single maximum, especially near deep nulls.
:::

## TS-Frequency

The prolate spheroid has length `140 mm`, equatorial radius `10 mm`, broadside incidence, seawater density `1026.8 kg m^-3`, and seawater sound speed `1477.3 m s^-1`.
